content.title: Population Density
content.summary: Population density is population per unit area.
content.explanation: It indicates the concentration of people in a given area.
content.when_to_use: Use when population and land area are given.
conditions: Use the same area unit throughout.

example.question: A region has 10,000 people and area 100 km².

common_mistakes: Reversing population and area.
